text.p: 3CI Complete Compliance Corp said on Friday that Arthur Anderson LLP had resigned as its principal accountant and that it is seeking another firm to audit its 1996 financial statements for the fiscal year ending September 30.

The company said Arthur Anderson modified its 1995 opinion regarding "liquidity issues confronting the company and an explanatory paragraph describing an uncertainty with respect to the outcome of certain litigation filed against the company."
3CI said its 1994 opinion was modified for a "matter paragraph discussing certain operating and liquidity issues confronting the company."
"They modified their opinion to emphasize these matters," said 3CI Comptroller John Weaver.
The company said Arthur Anderson resigned September 13.

The company emphasized that for fiscal 1995 and the period through September 13, 1996, "there were no disagreements with Arthur Anderson LLP on any matter of accounting principle or practices, financial disclosure or auditing scope or procedures."
The company said that audit reports for 1994, 1995 and the period through September 13, 1996, "did not contain any adverse opinion or disclaimer of opinion."
